newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Kabila flies to Lubumbashi after Zaire talks.
newsitem.headline: Kabila flies to Lubumbashi after Zaire talks.

text.p: Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila, fresh from negotiations with President Mobutu Sese Seko, was flying back to his stronghold of Lubumbashi on Sunday after a brief stopover in Angola, an Angolan official said.
"Mr Kabila has gone back to Lubumbashi," an official with the office of Angolan President Eduardo dos Santos told reporters at Luanda airport.
Kabila met Angolan officials for about 45 minutes at the airport before leaving on a jet owned by the Angolan state oil company SONANGOL. He did not speak to reporters.

Earlier, South African President Nelson Mandela hosted a meeting between Kabila and Mobutu aboard a ship in Congo's port of Pointe Noire. Kabila said his forces would keep advancing on the Zairean capital Kinshasa while Mobutu considered his demand that he resign.
